dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Ugh, how am I supposed to contact these two authors in this situation...

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Oh! Traveler, it's you... Thank goodness you're here. I was just in need of someone's help!

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Here's the problem: Yae Publishing House's annual novel-writing competition is about to begin, and as is our rule, we plan to invite a few of our writers to serve on the judging panel.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: However, we have two writers who are neither Inazuman, nor do they currently reside in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: As you know, the journey here is a long and tiring one over land and sea, and it will be quite the undertaking to bring both authors here.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: It would be nice, of course, if they could come. But regardless, it would not be polite of us to not even give them so much as notification that the event is occurring.

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: So I thought that if someone could at least send them a gift, the basic courtesies would at least be satisfied. And we could also attach a letter discussing future manuscripts— *cough* I mean...

dialogues.speaker: Aratani
dialogues.text: Would you be willing to help me out?

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Thank goodness! I'm counting on you then, Traveler!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: One of them is named Zhenyu, and the other is... Chang the Ninth.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Chang the Ninth's story, known as the "First Apprentice of Guhua," is a tale about the first apprentice of a famed martial arts school in Liyue and a young girl from Inazuma whom he took on as a junior apprentice.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: If you were to ask me, the themes and plot are just a little outdated by this point in time, but enough readers buy it to keep sales up.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: We often ask people to send some letters to him to suggest certain changes he might make in future works, by which he might perhaps make a breakthrough...

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: But we have never received a reply. Perhaps the letters were lost on the way, or...

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Now this one, I have no idea about. It's likely a pen name of some sort.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: But the book "A Legend of Sword"? That one's an earth-shatterer and a world-shaker, make no mistake!

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Both the setting and the story have sent veritable shocks throughout the literary world!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, where do I find this writer, then...

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: Hmm. I believe that this writer also lives in Liyue. According to a traveling merchant who brought this book back to Inazuma, he first found this text at Wanwen Bookhouse.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: I think that if you ask the staff at Wanwen Bookhouse, you should be able to find this author.

response.speaker: Aratani
response.text: However... *cough* Well, never mind that for now. Here are the presents and the letters. I'm putting this in your reliable hands, Traveler!
